text:
maria: quick question — continuous-batcher placement + queue shape. tiny requests keep hitting tail when mixed with long ones, does per-tenant microqueue for tiny reqs make sense or stick with a shared slab and smarter eviction?
kevin: tradeoff: microqueues give isolation but fragment capacity and complicate packing. shared slab is denser but needs eviction/priority logic.
anna: remember KV-cache locality: per-tenant lanes make pinning and warmups much easier.
josh: saw noisy tenants with lots of 32-64 token calls starving batch formation. proposal: hybrid — fastlane microqueues for <=128-token fast requests, shared slab for everything else.
sophie: eviction model matters. credit-based soft eviction w/ router backpressure (reason codes) seems better than hard kill. let callers fallback.
maria: rough enqueue flow i sketched: if (fastlane.accepts(req)) enqueue_fastlane; else if (slab.has_space()) enqueue_slab; else candidate = select_preemptable(slab, req.priority, req.deadline); if (candidate) preempt(candidate) else route_to_slowpath. knobs: fastlane_size, slab_headroom_pct, preempt_window, eviction_order.
carol: preemption cost is real: wasted KV warmups and partial GPU work. prefer reserve ~8% headroom per slab and try draining before preempt.
kevin: telemetry needs: per-tenant enqueue/drop, preempt_count, preempt_penalty_ms, slab_token_occupancy, backpressure_reason. will help tune headroom.
josh: add automatic model_fallback: on preempt/slowpath try quantized fallback model to preserve latency SLA.
sophie: streaming responses are special — they hold slots for long. options: token-account streaming separately or move streaming to dedicated pool.
maria: experiment plan: 1) hybrid slab + small fastlane threshold + 8% reserved headroom, 2) credit-based soft-eviction (candidate.priority < incoming.priority && candidate.age > preempt_window), 3) router handshake includes deadline_hint and model_fallback flag, 4) emit eviction/backpressure telemetry + reason codes.
deploy-bot: created INF-4721 'hybrid-slab-eviction-experiment' and linked RFC PR https://git.internal/r/redwood/infer/pulls/1234 :white_check_mark:
kevin: can we run sims on last-quarter traces (burst-small, mixed long/short) and sweep knobs before landing?
maria: yes, i'll run sim sweeps next week and post numbers here. thanks everyone :pray:
